## As of Jan. 11, 2025


A wildfire that started in one area of Los Angeles on Tuesday continues to affect the region.
DaVita’s care teams are focused on ensuring the safety of our patients, themselves and their families. As the situation evolves, we will continue to provide updates on how DaVita centers are being affected by the fires.


For the latest information, please call DaVita Guest Services at 1-800-400-8331.


Dial 9-1-1 if you need urgent medical care or emergency assistance.
